How to read the comparison: “FY26 Adopted” is the original amount in the FY2025-2026 adopted budget. “FY26 Current” is the 2026 budget column printed in the September 10, 2026 work budget, so it can differ if the budget was amended during the year. The FY2026-2027 PDF is an image-only scan, so its rows were OCR-extracted. Tap any line item to see source-page and extraction-confidence information. Low and medium-confidence rows should be checked against the PDF before publication or a formal conclusion.
